subject: [PATCH 1/8] selftests/mm: add MADV_COLD and MADV_PAGEOUT contract tests

2026-10-14.patch_summary: This patch adds contract tests for the MADV_COLD and MADV_PAGEOUT hints in the Linux kernel's selftests/mm module. The tests cover basic behavior, including that MADV_COLD does not populate PTE holes or fault swapped pages back in, and neither hint can be applied to a locked VMA. The tests also verify the swapped-page test works correctly when swap is available. The patch introduces new files for the kselftest harness and a C file containing the test code.
